title: Tensions rise in two ceasefires in the Middle East. And, the Navy secretary ousted
summary: Tensions are rising in the Middle East as shaky ceasefire agreements between the U.S., Israel and Iran, and Lebanon and Israel, are tested. And, the Secretary of the Navy is out of the role.
contentText:
